rationale: C03 plausibly supplied the short commendatory-letter template used by the child: appreciation for a report of successful progress, praise for the people responsible, and a concluding statement that the achievement reflects credit on the country. C09 is also a close accomplishment-and-appreciation letter, while C05 shares the opening formula about appreciating a report but concerns a prospective program and lacks the child's full sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I greatly appreciate your report on the success of the Veterans Administration program
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I appreciate very much your thoughtfulness in writing me relative to the progress that has been made by the Commission
shared_material.explanation: Both open by expressing appreciation for a report or communication describing successful institutional progress.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You and all who cooperated with you in this program are to be highly commended.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: You have enlisted the services of some of our most outstanding leaders... Please convey to them my personal appreciation of their willingness to serve
shared_material.explanation: Both extend the President's appreciation beyond the addressee to the collaborators responsible for the program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In your accomplishment, Americans everywhere can take a great and justifiable pride.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The country is to be congratulated that you have once again been willing to undertake leadership in this work.
shared_material.explanation: Both close the commendation by casting the recipient's administrative achievement as a source of national credit.
